{
  "name": "loss_tanh_weighted_advantage_rank",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise classification to a smooth rank-weighted advantage loss that uses tanh as a soft nonlinear transform to scale the preference signal and weights the loss by the relative advantage magnitude to emphasize stronger preference pairs.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_norm = tanh(clamp(advantage_gap, -10, 10))\nloss_raw = -adv_norm * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l)\nweights = sigmoid(abs(advantage_gap)) * weight\nloss = mean(loss_raw * weights)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_weighted_advantage",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh_linear",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_advantage"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "clamp",
    "sigmoid",
    "abs",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "neg"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n\n    adv_clamped = ops.clamp(adv_gap, -10.0, 10.0)\n    adv_norm = ops.tanh(adv_clamped)\n    diff = lpw - lpl\n    loss_raw = - adv_norm * diff\n    weight_mod = ops.sigmoid(ops.abs(adv_gap))\n    total_weight = weight * weight_mod\n    weighted_loss = loss_raw * total_weight\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_sumagg",
  "intuition": "rule_based: pairwise logsigmoid loss with sum aggregation replacing mean",
  "pseudocode": "loss = sum(-logsigmoid(clamp(alpha*scale*(lpw-lpl), -20, 20)) * weight)",

  ],

  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.sum(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_diff_squared",
  "intuition": "Instead of modeling preference via a margin and sigmoid function, this loss treats the difference in log probabilities relative to the advantage gap as a regression target, minimizing the squared error. This paradigm shifts from a margin/logsigmoid approach to a regression-based paradigm, focusing on matching advantage signals directly with predicted preference differences.",
  "pseudocode": "target = advantage_gap\nprediction = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nloss = weight * (prediction - target)^2\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_regression",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "identity",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    sq_error = ops.mul(ops.sub(diff, adv_gap), ops.sub(diff, adv_gap))\n    if weight is not None:\n        sq_error = ops.mul(sq_error, weight)\n    return ops.mean(sq_error)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_ranking_margin_exp",
  "intuition": "Instead of a classic margin-based logsigmoid loss on log-probs or costs, use an exponential penalty on the difference between advantage gaps and log-prob gaps, encouraging the model to rank pairs proportionally to their advantage difference with an explicit margin, aggregating by weighted mean to emphasize hard pairs.",
  "pseudocode": "for each pair: diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - margin * advantage_gap; loss = weight * exp(-diff); final_loss = mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking_margin",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "exponential_decay",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "exp",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_gap"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin = float(extra.get('margin', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin', 1.0)))\n    diff = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(margin, advantage_gap))\n    loss = ops.exp(ops.neg(diff))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n        return ops.div(ops.sum(loss), ops.sum(weight))\n    else:\n        return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_ranking",
  "intuition": "Instead of using a margin with logsigmoid on log-prob differences, this loss uses advantage signals to weight a differentiable ranking loss based on a hinge with a learnable margin, promoting correct rank ordering with explicit margin enforcement and linear penalty beyond margin.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = hyperparam_margin\nadv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l\nlog_prob_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nhinge_loss = relu(margin - log_prob_diff)\nweighted_loss = hinge_loss * clamp(adv_diff, min=0)\nloss = mean(weighted_loss * weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "hinge",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_clamped"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "relu",
    "clamp",
    "mean",
    "sub",
    "mul"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    margin = float(extra.get('margin', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin', 1.0)))\n    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    adv_diff_clamped = ops.clamp(adv_diff, 0.0, None)  # only positive advantage differences\n    log_prob_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin, log_prob_diff))\n    loss = ops.mul(hinge, adv_diff_clamped)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_kl_divergence_000_advantage",
  "intuition": "A generative modeling inspired pairwise loss that treats the difference in log probabilities as logits and aligns the advantage signal with a soft target distribution, using a KL divergence paradigm instead of margin-based losses.",
  "pseudocode": "p = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)\ntarget = sigmoid(advantage_w - advantage_l)\nloss = kl_divergence(target || p)\nweighted_loss = weight * loss\nfinal_loss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_kl_divergence",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "sigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "sigmoid",
    "log",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "add",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    \n    p = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(lpw, lpl))\n    target = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l))\n    \n    # KL divergence between Bernoulli distributions: target*log(target/p) + (1-target)*log((1-target)/(1-p))\n    epsilon = 1e-7\n    p_clamped = ops.clamp(p, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)\n    target_clamped = ops.clamp(target, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)\n    term1 = ops.mul(target_clamped, ops.log(ops.div(target_clamped, p_clamped)))\n    term2 = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(target_clamped), target_clamped),\n                     ops.log(ops.div(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), target_clamped), ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), p_clamped))))\n    kl = ops.add(term1, term2)\n    if weight is not None:\n        kl = ops.mul(kl, weight)\n    return kl.mean()"
}

  "name": "combined_logsigmoid_cost_and_logprob_gap_stable",
  "intuition": "The original candidate combined scaled log-prob difference and a cost gap term, clamped to [-20,20], then applied logsigmoid.     x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = loss * weight

{
  "name": "pairwise_advantage_rank_smoothstep_loss",
  "intuition": "Shift from sigmoid/tanh links and margin-based losses to a smoothstep-shaped scaled squared difference paradigm.   "pseudocode": "def smoothstep(x):
    x_clamped = clamp(x, 0, 1)
    return 3*x_clamped**2 - 2*x_clamped**3

scaled_gap = (advantage_gap - min_adv) / (max_adv - min_adv)

logit_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):

    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']

    max_adv = float(extra.get('max_adv', 10.0))

    # Scale advantage gap to [0,1]
    adv_scaled = ops.div(ops.sub(adv_gap, min_adv), max_adv - min_adv)
    adv_clamped = ops.clamp(adv_scaled, 0.0, 1.0)

    # Smoothstep function: 3x^2 - 2x^3
    adv_sq = ops.mul(adv_clamped, adv_clamped)
    adv_cb = ops.mul(adv_sq, adv_clamped)

    logit_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    pred_score = ops.sigmoid(logit_diff)

    error = ops.sub(pred_score, preference_target)
    sq_error = ops.mul(error, error)

    # Weight modifier: square advantage gap to highlight strong preferences
    adv_gap_sq = ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap)
    weight_mod = ops.mul(weight, adv_gap_sq)

  "intuition": "This loss shifts from margin and sigmoid-based paradigms to a geometric perspective by encouraging the directional alignment (cosine similarity) of log probability differences with the advantage gap. It treats preference as vector alignment, penalizing disagreement in sign or direction proportionally, fostering more stable and interpretable ranking signals.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nadv = advantage_gap\ncos_sim = (diff * adv) / (sqrt(diff^2) * sqrt(adv^2) + eps)\nloss = weight * (1 - cos_sim)\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_geometric_alignment",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",

  },

    "add",
    "div",
    "sqrt",
    "mean",
    "abs"
  ],

      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    eps = 1e-8\n\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    numerator = ops.mul(diff, adv_gap)\n    denom = ops.mul(ops.sqrt(ops.add(ops.mul(diff, diff), eps)), ops.sqrt(ops.add(ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap), eps)))\n    cos_sim = ops.div(numerator, denom)\n    loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(cos_sim), cos_sim))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "pairwise_kl_advantage_loss",
  "intuition": "This loss aligns the difference in log probabilities with an advantage-based target distribution using a sigmoid link, promoting preference consistency through KL divergence. It effectively leverages advantage signals to guide the model towards preferred pairs while maintaining smooth gradients for optimization.",
  "pseudocode": "p = sigmoid(log_prob_w - log_prob_l)
target = sigmoid(advantage_w - advantage_l)
loss = kl_divergence(target || p)
weighted_loss = weight * loss
final_loss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_kl_divergence",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "sigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": ["sigmoid", "log", "sub", "mul", "add", "mean"],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_w", "advantage_l"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']
    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    
    p = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(lpw, lpl))
    target = ops.sigmoid(ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l))
    
    epsilon = 1e-7
    p_clamped = ops.clamp(p, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
    target_clamped = ops.clamp(target, epsilon, 1 - epsilon)
    term1 = ops.mul(target_clamped, ops.log(ops.div(target_clamped, p_clamped)))
    term2 = ops.mul(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(target_clamped), target_clamped),
                     ops.log(ops.div(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), target_clamped), ops.sub(ops.ones_like(p_clamped), p_clamped))))
    kl = ops.add(term1, term2)
    if weight is not None:
        kl = ops.mul(kl, weight)
    return kl.mean()"
}

    kl = ops.add(term1, term2)

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):

    cost_a = batch['cost_a']
    cost_b = batch['cost_b']
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    
    temperature = float(extra.get('temperature', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('temperature', 1.0)))
    
    # Negative adjusted scores incorporate cost and regret
    neg_adjusted_w = ops.neg(ops.add(cost_a, delta_regret))
    neg_adjusted_l = ops.neg(ops.add(cost_b, delta_regret))
    
    # Compute target distribution with softmax over negative adjusted scores (numerical stability by max)
    max_adj = ops.maximum(neg_adjusted_w, neg_adjusted_l)
    adj_w_shifted = ops.sub(neg_adjusted_w, max_adj)
    adj_l_shifted = ops.sub(neg_adjusted_l, max_adj)
    exp_w = ops.exp(ops.div(adj_w_shifted, temperature))

    log_softmax_l = ops.sub(ops.div(lpl_shifted, temperature), ops.log(sum_exp_logits))

    if weight is not None:
